tours.title: Build Your Own Tour – Pay by the Hour
tours.photo_alt: River tubing on a Grenada river, seen from above
tours.intro: Explore Grenada at your own pace with our flexible private hourly tour option.
paragraphs: Choose where you want to go, what you want to see, and how you want to spend your time. Whether you want to visit a waterfall, relax on the beach, explore the rainforest, discover local culture, stop for lunch, shop, take photos, or simply enjoy a scenic drive around the island — you’re in control.
Pay by the hour and create an experience that works for your schedule and interests.
Perfect for families, couples, friends, cruise passengers, and private groups who want the freedom to customize their Grenada adventure.
tours.closing: Tell us what you have in mind, and King J’s will help make it happen. Your time. Your choices. Your Grenada adventure.

spicemas.title: Spice Mas, cricket and groups
spicemas.text: Fetes that run to the small hours, cricket at the National Stadium, dive shop shuttles and jouvert mornings. The van seats twelve together, and pickups get arranged around your band’s timing.
